test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Originate
solution:
The correct answer is **Terminate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM of "*Originate*" is Terminate.
 
• **Antonym - **The words that give opposite meaning of given word.
 
 
• *For example : Antonym of good is bad.*
 
 
 
• **Originate - **Have a specified beginning.** **
 
 
• **​***For example : "The word originated as a marketing term."*
 
 
 
• Terminate - Bring to an end.
 
 
• *For example : "She was advised to terminate the contract."*​
 
 
 
• *​*Emerge **- **Move out of or away from something and become visible.** **
 
 
• ​*For example : "He appeared out of no where."*​
 
 
 
• Exist **- **Have objective reality or being.
 
 
• *For example : "There existed no organization to cope with espionage."*​
 
 
 
• Continue **- **Persist in an activity or process.
 
 
• ​*For example : "She was unable to continue with her job."*​
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Antonym of **Emerge **is **Appear**.
 
• Antonym of Terminate is **Originate**.
 
• Antonym of **Exist **is **Die**.
 
• Antonym of **Continue **is **Stop**.
